window_choice: February2024 is the latest calendar month with frozen H01 activity (5 trades, both directions); full available month tested with Jan22 warmup. Selected using entry counts only, not P&L, to exercise execution. Not out-of-sample performance evidence.
time_conversion: Bounded +7200 seconds interval independently aligned to UTC quote history before any native performance run; pooled and each weekly return correlation pass registered thresholds.
signal: H1 prior-20-bar channel on separately aggregated bid/ask OHLC midpoint; simple mean of 14 true ranges; completed bars only.
risk: Original signal-close planned-risk filter remains USD0.05. DDHaltUSD=0 retains frozen H01; Step8 drawdown kill switch implemented but disabled, since enabling it changes the frozen schedule.
execution: Native broker tester SL/TP on processed generated ticks versus unchanged frozen H01 M5 OHLC stop-first reference. All differences retained. No changed strategy/risk parameters.
data_model: MT5 Every tick generated from actual broker M1 bars; historical M1 spread creates Ask. NOT real historical ticks. Export each processed OnTick quote; replay identical stream in Python.
